games.title: Reading Detective
games.description: Use unit evidence to solve each reading clue.

rounds.prompt: According to 'The Roof of Africa', why do gelada monkeys move to the cliff ledges at dusk?
choices: They retreat to narrow cliff ledges to sleep because predators cannot follow them there.
They eat dried dates and roasted chickpeas in the shade of the outcrop.
She notices conspicuous signs of erosion near the narrow rock bridge: the stones are loose and a crack splits the path near the end.
rounds.answer: They retreat to narrow cliff ledges to sleep because predators cannot follow them there.
rounds.explanation: The wildlife paragraph says geladas retreat at dusk to sleep on narrow cliff ledges 'where predators cannot follow', so the ledges keep them safe through the night.

rounds.prompt: What do the students eat during their midday rest beneath the rock outcrop?
choices: A radio call reports that Tariq has been found with a minor injury, and by sunrise he limps into the courtyard with his clothes torn and covered in dust.
She promises the group will go after Tariq if he falls, she keeps the team together on the safer long route, and she urges them to catch up carefully instead of splitting.
They eat dried dates and roasted chickpeas in the shade of the outcrop.
rounds.answer: They eat dried dates and roasted chickpeas in the shade of the outcrop.
rounds.explanation: In the midday rest under the rock outcrop, the group huddled in the shade 'eating dried dates and roasted chickpeas' while the heat shimmered on the stones below.

rounds.prompt: When the path forks below the citadel, what evidence persuades Zara to choose the longer route?
choices: They retreat to narrow cliff ledges to sleep because predators cannot follow them there.
She notices conspicuous signs of erosion near the narrow rock bridge: the stones are loose and a crack splits the path near the end.
A radio call reports that Tariq has been found with a minor injury, and by sunrise he limps into the courtyard with his clothes torn and covered in dust.
rounds.answer: She notices conspicuous signs of erosion near the narrow rock bridge: the stones are loose and a crack splits the path near the end.
rounds.explanation: At the fork, Zara studies the terrain and notices conspicuous signs of erosion near the narrow bridge: the stones are loose and a crack splits the path near the end, so she chooses the longer, protected route.
